import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;
    
    static class Matrix {
        int h, w;
        long[][] a;
        
        Matrix(int n) {
            h = n;
            w = n;
            a = new long[n][n];
        }
        
        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            h = n;
            w = m;
            a = new long[n][m];
        }
        
        long get(int r, int c) {
            return a[r][c];
        }
        
        void set(int r, int c, long val) {
            a[r][c] = val;
        }
        
        Matrix add(Matrix m) {
            assert h == m.h && w == m.w;
            Matrix ret = new Matrix(h, w);
            for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < w; j++) {
                    ret.a[i][j] = (a[i][j] + m.a[i][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }
        
        Matrix sub(Matrix m) {
            assert h == m.h && w == m.w;
            Matrix ret = new Matrix(h, w);
            for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < w; j++) {
                    ret.a[i][j] = (a[i][j] - m.a[i][j] + MOD) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }
        
        Matrix mul(Matrix m) {
            assert w == m.h;
            Matrix ret = new Matrix(h, m.w);
            for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m.w; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < w; k++) {
                        ret.a[i][j] = (ret.a[i][j] + a[i][k] * m.a[k][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }
        
        Matrix mulAssign(Matrix m) {
            Matrix ret = mul(m);
            this.h = ret.h;
            this.w = ret.w;
            this.a = ret.a;
            return this;
        }
    }
    
    static Matrix unitMatrix(int n) {
        Matrix ret = new Matrix(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret.set(i, i, 1);
        }
        return ret;
    }
    
    static Matrix matrixPower(Matrix base, int exp) {
        assert base.h == base.w;
        Matrix result = unitMatrix(base.h);
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = result.mul(base);
            }
            base = base.mul(base);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    static Matrix[] a = new Matrix[65];
    
    static Matrix calc(int i, int k) {
        return matrixPower(a[i + k], k - i).mul(matrixPower(a[i], i));
    }
    
    static long solve(long n, long k) {
        long cnt = 0;
        long tmp = n;
        while (tmp != 0) {
            tmp /= k;
            ++cnt;
        }
        
        Matrix[] b = new Matrix[(int)cnt + 5];
        Matrix[] c = new Matrix[(int)cnt + 5];
        Matrix[] d = new Matrix[(int)k + 1];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < b.length; i++) {
            b[i] = null;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < c.length; i++) {
            c[i] = null;
        }
        
        b[0] = a[(int)k - 1];
        c[0] = matrixPower(b[0], (int)k - 1);
        b[1] = calc((int)k - 1, (int)k);
        c[1] = matrixPower(b[1], (int)k - 1);
        
        Matrix s = unitMatrix(2 * (int)k + 1);
        
        for (int j = 2; j <= cnt + 1; j++) {
            b[j] = calc((int)(k - j % k), (int)k);
            s = s.mul(c[j - 1]);
            b[j] = b[j].mul(s);
            c[j] = matrixPower(b[j], (int)k - 1);
        }
        
        int idx = 1;
        long rem = n % k;
        n -= rem;
        int q = 0;
        tmp = n;
        if (tmp != 0) {
            while (tmp % k == 0) {
                ++q;
                tmp /= k;
            }
        }
        q = (int)((k - q % k) % k);
        
        Matrix ans = unitMatrix(2 * (int)k + 1);
        ans = matrixPower(a[q], (int)rem).mul(matrixPower(a[q + (int)k], Math.max((int)(rem - q), 0)));
        n /= k;
        
        if (n == 0) {
            return (ans.get(2 * (int)k, 0) + ans.get(0, 0)) % MOD;
        }
        
        --n;
        while (n > 0) {
            long t = n % k;
            if (t != 0) {
                ans = ans.mul(matrixPower(b[idx], (int)t));
            }
            n /= k;
            ++idx;
        }
        ans = ans.mul(b[1]);
        
        return (ans.get(2 * (int)k, 0) + ans.get(0, 0)) % MOD;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] line = br.readLine().split(" ");
        long n = Long.parseLong(line[0]);
        long k = Long.parseLong(line[1]);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (int)k + 1; i++) {
            a[i] = new Matrix(2 * (int)k + 1);
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                a[i].set(0, j, 1);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 2 * (int)k - 1; j++) {
                a[i].set(j + 1, j, 1);
            }
            a[i].set(2 * (int)k, 0, 1);
            a[i].set(2 * (int)k, 2 * (int)k, 1);
        }
        
        System.out.println(solve(n, k));
    }
}
